# tree entry mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:treeEntryMode`](gmeow-treeEntryMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/treeEntryMode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The git file mode of a tree entry — e.g. '100644' (regular file), '100755' (executable), '040000' (directory), '160000' (submodule), '120000' (symlink). Functional: one mode per entry.
